title: Independent Contractor Agreement

tracker.notes: Jay wants to send by Thu 1 Oct. India freelancer template - only name and rate changed

verdict: Do not sign yet: 4 blocking issues to resolve

findings.title: Wrong AtliQ entity: AtliQ Technologies Pvt Ltd (India) for a USA counterparty
findings.explanation: Per atliq_entities.md, AtliQ Inc serves US clients only and Pvt Ltd serves everyone else. This draft names AtliQ Technologies Pvt Ltd (India), so invoicing entity, tax regime (GST vs US) and bank account will not line up.
findings.suggestion: Replace with AtliQ Inc (US) in the parties clause, signature block and notices.
findings.quote: **AtliQ Technologies Pvt Ltd**, a company incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013, CIN U72900MH2019PTC321456, GSTIN 27AAKCA4821F1Z3, having its registered office at 4th Floor, Baner Business Bay, Pune 411045, Maharashtra, India (the "**Company**"); and
findings.precedent: Entity/invoice mismatches caused payment delays twice in 2025 (atliq_entities.md).

findings.title: Fairness: full-time exclusivity on a freelancer
findings.explanation: Bars the contractor from other work during and after the engagement. Heavy for an individual; post-term non-competes are also widely unenforceable (India: Contract Act s.27; many US states restrict them).
findings.suggestion: Drop exclusivity and the post-term non-compete; keep confidentiality and a narrow non-solicit of AtliQ's clients the contractor served.
findings.quote: 3.1 During the term of this Agreement, the Contractor shall devote his professional working time exclusively to the Company and shall not, directly or indirectly, provide services to, or be engaged or employed by, any other person, firm or company, whether paid or unpaid, without the Company's prior written consent.

findings.title: Fairness: worldwide post-term non-compete on a freelancer
findings.explanation: Bars the contractor from other work during and after the engagement. Heavy for an individual; post-term non-competes are also widely unenforceable (India: Contract Act s.27; many US states restrict them).
findings.suggestion: Drop exclusivity and the post-term non-compete; keep confidentiality and a narrow non-solicit of AtliQ's clients the contractor served.
findings.quote: 8.1 For a period of twelve (12) months after termination or expiry of this Agreement, the Contractor shall not, anywhere in the world, directly or indirectly, provide any software or data services to any person, whether as an employee, consultant, contractor, partner or otherwise, in competition with the Company.

findings.title: India template sent to a US party
findings.explanation: The draft asks a US resident for an Indian PAN/GSTIN, pays in INR and is governed by India law with Indian courts. It was built from the India template with 'only name and rate changed' (tracker C-040).
findings.suggestion: Use the AtliQ Inc US contractor template (as used for Daniel Ortiz): USD payment by ACH, US law, W-9.
